packageRules.description: Dioxus crates are pinned to one version, so they move together.
Small updates in one merge request. grit-lib is the git engine, reviewed on every bump, so it gets its own.
grit-lib releases almost daily and breaks its API on the way to 0.6, so an update waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard and comes with a port of branchbooks-git.
Images in .gitlab-ci.yml stay pinned by digest.
